note: Niue: nationals of the countries and territories listed need no visa and get a 30-day visitor permit on arrival (taken as free); everyone else applies for a visitor visa before travelling. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Immigration Act 2011 as the Ministry of Finance publishes it: it defines a visitor as staying up to 30 days and leaves the exemptions from a visa to regulations by Cabinet, not found; the list of exempt countries stands on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of New Zealand
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories do not need to apply for a visa before travelling and may obtain a 30-day visitor permit on arrival: Andorra Australia Austria Belgium Canada Cyprus Denmark Fiji Finland France Germany Greece Iceland Ireland Italy Japan Kiribati Liechtenstein Luxembourg Malta Marshall Islands Monaco Nauru Netherlands New Caledonia Norway Portugal Samoa San Marino Singapore Solomon Islands Spain Sweden Switzerland Tonga Tuvalu United Kingdom United States Vanuatu Vatican City ... All other passport holders must apply for a visitor visa before traveling.

sources.title: Niue, Immigration Act 2011 (2011/309, 7 April 2011), published by Niue's Ministry of Finance
sources.said: "visitor" means any person not being a prohibited immigrant who enters Niue for a period not exceeding 30 days and who is in possession of a valid passport or other relevant travel document ... (2) Cabinet may make regulations under this Act to exempt any person or [class of persons from the requirement to hold a visa] ... (a) visitor visas for tourists to Niue;
